negativeOrNullFindings: PMID 24300782 - no benefit in spinal muscular atrophy.

The long-acting comparators (PMIDs 35405011, 32603494, 41420532) are trials designed to show non-inferiority TO daily somatropin; they position somatropin as the standard being displaced, which is the honest framing.
This dossier's largest integrity risk is the anti-ageing use case. The screened set contains no RCT supporting GH for healthy ageing; say so explicitly rather than omitting the question.
cautions: Somatropin is a 191-residue protein. If the site defines its scope as peptides, publishing this requires an explicit editorial decision about proteins - flag it rather than assume.

Somatrogon, somapacitan, lonapegsomatropin and somavaratan are separate molecules with their own approvals. Attributing their results to somatropin would repeat the parent/derivative error already documented in this repo's lessons file.
Non-medical use of GH is heavily searched. The no-dosing, no-sourcing and no-medical-advice bans are load-bearing on this page.
